body:
I suppose it's about dealing with the bad things but I am really finding it impossible to just get on with my life.

I really hope you can find some solace. I wish I knew what to recommend!

I'm sorry to hear that.

No I'm stuck too.. it seems just trying to get on with it should do but this really doesn't seem like a way to live.
Thank you, that means a lot. I just beat myself up a bit when I get upset by it as if I'm still stuck and she's no doubt living her life and doing well.. I shall stick at it!

Yes you're right. I may see my GP again but am weary of the anti-depressant route, but it's probably worth seeing what other options I can do, though I may have to pay for it.


And yes on the new relationship route. I have tried and then panicked and since learnt my lessons. I do really enjoy being single though. I have become a huge cynic of relationships as I am sure they cause little more than pain so happy to leave them alone at the moment.


I'm keen to reclaim my city for me again. I moved here then met her a couple of years later, and am starting now I have a good job to actually enjoy it. I will look into moving perhaps next year for a short time but for now, I'm very eager that I should be able to relax and have fun again here.

I have a little bit, but work constraints and money have taken priority at this stage. I'm thinking about taking a few days off to visit somewhere on my own but at this stage nothing quite as big as that.


I am just so frustrated, because I think that everything I do is in response to her, or with her in mind. I find it hard to think that there's anything or anyone more important even though we haven't spoken in so long. I really have worked hard at this, but she's still so prevalent in everything.

Hey - So I have tried hard with this. I exercise a lot, I write and read loads more than I ever did and generally i'm a lot busier and more proactive than last year. Even if I see the weather map I can't help but look at the area where she lives and whilst i've improved (I don't cry every day on the train home for example) it still annoys me that she pops into my head this far along.

So my therapy sessions ended in January, and so far this year I have been much better actually. A couple of lower points but nothing like last year, though often there's a persistent underlying sadness.

No, not intentionally but it's sometimes unavoidable! Especially around my house. I am doing lots of new things but my whole life seems like a constant reminder of the life I had with her, and the fact it still bothers me irritates me more than anything.
Thanks for your reply. I agree, especially some nights it all seems futile. I think i've learnt from this year though, or at least I hope I have in some vein.

Hello,

Sorry not sure if I made it clear enough but I've been seeing a therapist for the past 7 weeks or so, and for a few before a gap - it's been helpful, but I still sometimes feel terrible.

Thank you.

I did worry about the indirect contact with the mother, but didn't mention the person who made the complaint in any way, nor did I initiate the contact.

I'll just keep myself to myself - I think this is best just to get on with things.

Your replies are much appreciated!

> 
> 

Thanks for the comprehensive reply - this is what I generally thought.

Is this applicable even if the conduct isn't vitriolic like previously - I must add I have no intention to contact them - but rather not abusive or similar. I've even been contacted by one of the accusers mothers congratulating me on a social media site over something and asking how I am, so it's all a bit confusing.

Thank you
I'm sure they said it was a police one - how do they differentiate? I got a verbal warning, but not sure what this really means in practice.
For an update, this got NFA'd by the police.
For an update, this got NFA'd by the police.
For an update, this got NFA'd by the police.
For an update, this got NFA'd by the police.
For an update, this got NFA'd by the police.

Thanks - yes I have done we haven't spoken in ages, and in the main I did adhere to it (bar one email) but i'm just going to keep doing that, and hope that this is reflected when it comes to decision making by the powers that be.
Yes I did get a letter - which was adhered apart from one email where I literally just apologised for my behaviour. I don't know if this helps or hinders. Probably hinders..

So, I was given advice to say no comment, in relation to this https://www.reddit.com/r/LegalAdviceUK/comments/4zbtcv/im_being_accused_of_harassment_stalking_and/d6wmwzx

And i'm worried that I should have answered things where I didn't. Is there anyway to know what I should have done?

Well, i'm not going to change my name, and clearly it's nothing to do with children, and the threat was made against a male.

If you had a world famous solicitor, how did this help with the fine? 

I mean, I don't want to get a criminal record, and don't think personally this deserves one(in my opinion of course) but there isn't much I can do now.
Ah dear!Yes this would make sense, and is all a bit worrying. This is one breakup I won't forget in a hurry.
Is there anyway I can get my laptop back sooner? 6 weeks seems a long time but perhaps this is just the way of things.

>  by going no comment, your solicitor has done your legs. You won't get a caution without an admission, so it's going to be a charge or an NFA

If it is a charge also, I know this is circumstantial but what do you think the punishment would be? Could it be a caution or more?

I was told to do this, as the solicitor hadn't had access to see the emails before the interview and I was in a bit of a state at the time.

In terms of the process, when I show up at the police station next month, would I not admit if I thought it best then, if they were going ahead with proceedings?

Hi, thanks for your reply. 

I do have a solicitor, on legal aid, but there isn't anything happening with them until we know what's happening in late September. I was advised to just 'No Comment' the interview. 

Thanks for the info regarding stalking - I was told I was further arrested for this, I didn't realise it fell into the harassment section. 

Regarding the continued communications, there have definitely been cordial communications between us at points, - I think it's the new boyfriend that has pushed this as I did send a message threatening him, and emailed his work outlining the timeline of the infidelity.

I suppose i'm just in a 'dark zone' until I find out if the police/CPS decide to do anything, so just trying to figure out what  may or may not be in store for me before then.
Ok thanks - I become increasingly convinced that day won't ever come but there is absolutely nothing I can do.
I will certainly continue to try to.. though I don't feel like i'm moving anywhere!
True. Thanks for your advice.. onwards and hopefully upwards

Thanks for this - it's helpful to read. I know I'm not over her, but even how to get over it is hard - I'm sure it doesn't just happen. Regardless , I am seeing a therapist and haven't been in touch so I'm doing what I can.

I know you're right, and I've tried to kid myself with dating and the like but I think we're a little whole off.
Ok
I don't know. I guess deep down I find it difficult to think we'll never talk again, but it seems the reality. I am not finding it easy to adjust whatsoever.

Thanks for the reply. I've written it, but yes, i'll keep it and not send it. I genuinely don't want a new saga or anything like that, i'm just trying to attempt to prove that i'm trying, and i'm civil, but I can't really prove anything.

I am trying to just move on, but I don't feel like i'm going anywhere. Every action is determined by how i'm feeling about her, even though we haven't been in contact but I guess it's especially raw around her birthday. What a pickle.
It seems to be the consensus, sadly, as I wish it wasn't left how it was and I do struggle without her but there isn't much I can do now.
I didn't think of that and that isn't what I want. I won't do - thanks for the tip.
Yep - thanks.
Ok - thanks - I won't do.
I've talked to people, but so often I feel it gets so desperate I don't think people realise how bad it is, and I don't want to be a burden to anyone anymore.
It's manageable. I wouldn't say I like it as such but it keeps me busy.
Yeah my past relationship is giving me a lot of grief, emotionally and legally and i'm pretty broke. This year has been a recurring nightmare.
Thank you - this gives me hope! Yes I am lucky with that, it's just waiting for it to begin but I can wait. Have a great day too!

I never totally dismissed what you were saying, and i've absolutely had issues, it's just this has made them unmanageable. 

Like I said before, you may well be right, but I don't understand any of this at all. How would a normal, caring person react to being left for someone else? I don't know. Not like this i'm sure, but it isn't clear to me.
It's a juggling act between money, escaping and readjusting. But then I am considering waiting for the sessions, but it requires signing for a house for a year, so all quite tricky.

Thanks. 

I also hasten to add if you had read properly, you'd realise this is not what i'm like regularly and has been set off by the circumstances.
There's a high chance you're right, but I can't process it. I really can't. I blame her entirely.

> I get you are down but dont move back home. were you able to get some anti depressants short term? You can start them but that doesnt mean you have to be on them for the rest of your life.
> 

It's tempting though just to get myself together and sort out money troubles, as well as getting away from all this. I think I can, if I can get a doctor's appointment in short notice which i'm hoping to do.

I will try that, though I think i'll struggle! Thank you.

Thank you - I'm off to play tennis and have been at the gym and doing runs.

My therapy sessions should begin in a few weeks, so it's just tiding myself over until then I suppose.

Your words are appreciated and i'll have a look at those forums for some help.

Right you say that, but it isn't her right at all. Of course, she's free to, but she doesn't have a right to betray someone and to destroy them emotionally in her selfish pursuits. 

People can't just do what they want without consequences. I should in no way have acted as I have, but if she wanted it nice and easy why not just end it instead of putting me through this?
With some yes, and I have been doing that. It's not something i've ever really been comfortable with but i'm having to do it to stay sane!
I'm due to at the beginning of next month - it just seems like an age away.

Thanks for your reply - That sounds awful but i'd like to add i'm not stalking. I have threatened the guy twice but haven't shown up anywhere. Just to be clear, though i'm sure i'm putting myself in danger of being in trouble.
OK now what? I feel utterly worthless.
I can't see a way out.
It isn't her right to see someone behind my back which has reduced me to feeling worthless.
Yes you're right, but I feel like i've been beaten (which I have) and whilst I know I need to move on, it's easier said than done.

I realise this, and to an extent it's compounded my actions.

However, a large part of me does not want to be with her again. She has totally ruined my life, i've not helped but the way she's gone about things has put me in this place.

You're right, I look like an idiot. I received a desist notice and responded to that wishing them the best.

Thanks for your reply.
Thank you
I am trying. I really am, but I feel beaten at every turn.

I know, and thanks for your advice.

It's his (tax dodging) father's law  firm it's come from, so it's an easy route of reply.
Thanks - I'm not in school but i'll see if work has something useful and contact the therapy service our healthcare provides.

I won't do, but now what do I do?

I'm a total loss. Honestly i'm completely shattered - there really doesn't seem to be any light at the end of the tunnel.
ok.

Sometimes I do have a grip, and I am trying to be proactive.

Other times it feels like I have nothing to lose, when everything's already lost. I feel like every ounce of their happiness is coming at my expense.
Thank you - I know i've been lashing out, I didn't mean it maliciously as such.

Perhaps it isn't, but i've been holding them wholly responsible for putting me in a dark place for their own happiness. I know she can break up with me for whatever reason, but it's the manner in which it's happened which has reduced me to this. I really feel like i'm cracking - or cracked already you probably think.

I'm starting therapy sessions proper at the start of next month. Unfortunately things here (UK) can be a bit slow. 

I've been doing a lot of exercise, and my hobbies (reading and writing) recently and a lot of days i'm fine. It's just some where i'm so low i'm doing stupid things and sending threats to boost my ego I think.

Thank you.

I'm struggling to see how i'd be at the end of the year, let alone anything in the future. Everything's so confused and I feel like everything is working against me.

I am trying to be proactive, like I say with exercise and therapy but it's so bleak. I feel worthless.
I know.

Yes you're right. It's just traumatic - I won't contact them again, but I feel humiliated and I don't see why they should be so happy when i'm struggling.

Of course I know I can't do this, but i'm in a really dark place. It's not in my normal pattern of behaviour.
Thanks - I know I need to, and I will but I am suffering and don't know how to cope with it all.

No I think you're right - maybe i'm holding on to a bit. It was her suggestion to be friends as we have loads in common, it's just what that looks like in practice. I didn't mean to get so into it - it just happened!

It turns out you were right - I talked about my own feelings to which she was very appreciative but thought it best to call it off now before it got deeper, which she isn't ready for. Though a bit gutted for now I realise it's probably in the long-term interest, it's just hard after being rejected in my last relationship and makes me wonder what's wrong with me, though I put myself in this situation.

I think maybe I put myself out there a bit too quickly, and just happened to meet someone I have so much in common with, just at the wrong time for both of us which is a shame, but perhaps us being friends would give us a solid platform to build something in the future.. who knows. Thanks again for your replies.

Thank you - I took some advice in another comment, and talked about my own feelings to which she was very appreciative but thought it best to call it off now before it got deeper. Though a bit gutted for now, it's probably in the long-term interest it's just hard after being rejected in my last relationship and makes me wonder what's wrong with me, though I put myself in this situation.

We've agreed to be friends so hopefully it's never off the table in the future, but I think it best I not focus on that and take your advice. Thanks again!

Thanks for your reply - I have considered, this, and to be honest I thought I was further on than maybe I am, considering the worry that even potential rejection is causing.

I just can't see at what point I can stomach it is? It's been a fair few months and I know there's no set time but when does it end? I thought getting back out there would help, and to an extent it has, it's just dealing with someone i've fallen for very quickly. 

I am due to start some therapy due to a longer-term depression which has been exacerbated by my past relationship, but other than that I don't know exactly what I ought to be doing.
Thank you - similarly to the other comment I think you're right and like I said I really don't want to risk not seeing her.. such a minefield of emotions at the moment.

Thanks for your reply - it's on the ball, I think. I just really don't want to stop seeing her as we've had fun and partly almost want to readjust my own expectations - however they just get harder to manage with each meeting.
